name: I-Sheng Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: I-Sheng Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd., based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, operates as an international supplier of a wide array of electrical and data transmission products. The company's core offerings include essential connectivity solutions such as plugs, connectors, power supply cords, LAN cables, and electronic signal cables. Its comprehensive product line further extends to specialized wiring, encompassing photovoltaic wires, hook-up wires, coaxial cables, telephone wires, and various computer and peripheral cables. Beyond industrial and commercial wiring, I-Sheng also manufactures consumer goods like power strips and night lights. Additionally, the company is deeply involved in the production of advanced materials. These include specialized compounds designed for properties such as oxygen index, thermal stability (including Congo red materials), as well as formulations for injection molding, non-migration, matte finishes, weather and oil resistance, and modified, elastic, and abrasive applications. Established in 1973, I-Sheng has a long-standing presence in the industry.
